items.question: Do I need to pay for the Gemini API?
items.answer: Free tier is available via Google AI Studio and usable with all text features. Generative features requires a billed account.

items.question: Which Photoshop versions are supported?
items.answer: Photoshop 2024 (v25.0) and later. CC subscription required (Insight is a plugin, not a replacement).

items.question: Does Insight work on Mac and Windows?
Is my data private?
items.answer: Insight uses your own Gemini API key. Images are processed by Google's API per their [privacy policy](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms). Insight itself stores no data.

items.question: Will my photos be trained on Google's servers?
items.answer: When using Paid Services, Google doesn't use your prompts or responses to improve our products. Always stay up to date with [Google's privacy policy](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms#data-use-paid).

items.question: Can I get a refund?
items.answer: Refer to Lemon Squeezy's refund policy. If you have a technical issue, contact the email listed in the footer.

items.question: How is this different from Photoshop's native AI?
items.answer: Insight support 4K generations, reads the photo's EXIF data, supports reference images, multiple variants, and adds critique/analysis/tutoring tools that Adobe doesn't offer.

items.question: How much does it actually cost to generate with Insight?
items.answer: Insight uses your own Gemini API key, so pricing is usage-based (per generation, model, and resolution). Competitor plans may use monthly credit buckets for partner models, and generation capacity depends on per-generation credit cost. Check current plan pages for up-to-date limits and promotions.

items.question: Will more AI models be supported?
items.answer: Yes. Additional public AI models are planned. Current support covers Gemini models via your own API key.

items.question: Do I need an internet connection?
items.answer: Yes, for AI features. The plugin panel itself opens offline, but generation/critique requires API access.

about.title: A note from the developer
about.subtitle: Enriching imagination, one pixel at a time.
about.text1: I've spent over 15 years behind a lens, balancing the art of photography with the technical demands of professional retouching. I built Insight because I wanted a tool that would help photographers enrich their imagination and achieve more with less effort.
about.text2: As a solo developer and a photographer first, my goal was simple: create a technical assistant that handles the hurdles of editing so you can stay focused on your creative vision. Insight is a passion project born from the belief that professional tools should be accessible, empowering, and above all, respectful of the artist.

footer.rights: Insight and SnapSelect are not affiliated with Adobe Inc. Adobe, Photoshop, and Lightroom are trademarks of Adobe Inc.

privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for Insight for Photoshop and Luvetis website.
privacy.intro: Luvetis ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you visit our website and use the Insight Adobe Photoshop Plugin.

sections.title: 1. DATA COLLECTION & USAGE
sections.content: We do not collect personal information unless you voluntarily provide it to us (for example, by sending us an email). Our website may use basic, anonymized analytics to understand how visitors interact with our site and to improve the user experience.

sections.title: 2. THE PLUGIN (INSIGHT)
sections.content: Insight is designed with privacy in mind. It is a "bring-your-own-key" (BYOK) tool, meaning it stores your Gemini API key locally on your device. We do not collect, transmit, or store your API keys or your Photoshop canvas data on our own servers.

sections.title: 3. THIRD-PARTY SERVICES
sections.content: To provide its features, the Software interacts with the following third-party services:
bullets: Google Gemini API: Image data and text prompts are transmitted directly to Google for processing. This data is governed by Google's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

Lemon Squeezy: All purchases and licensing are handled by Lemon Squeezy. They collect payment information and email addresses for license delivery. Please refer to the Lemon Squeezy Privacy Policy for details.

sections.title: 4. DATA SECURITY
sections.content: We implement reasonable security measures to protect the limited information we may have (such as email communications) from unauthorized access or disclosure.

sections.title: 5. YOUR RIGHTS
sections.content: Depending on your location, you may have rights regarding your personal data, including the right to access, correct, or request the deletion of any information you have shared with us via direct contact.

sections.title: 6. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.
